title: Pre-registered narrow JO grooming-afferent dose screen
objective: Screen narrowly selected JO-FV and JO-FD1 grooming-subclass populations for a selective antennal-grooming decoder response while excluding takeoff, flight, and jump responses.

design.sham_reuse: one no-intervention sham per seed is paired to every candidate dose for that seed
design.world: calm sham_grounded, zero wind, no target contact
design.execution: strict free-behavior; FlyVis CUDA; Warp CUDA; MaleCNS Triton CUDA; reduced body; MemoryMax=5G; LimitMEMLOCK=64M; RuntimeMaxSec=300; max_vram_gib=15.5
design.fallback_policy: Fail closed. CPU, stub, or non-CUDA fallback invalidates the run and stops the scan.

selector_audit.note: The type-and-subclass intersections are used explicitly. JO-FV alone includes ten cells outside subclass:grooming and is not used as the stimulation cohort.

specificity_and_target_gate.target_population_spikes: During the intervention window, total DNg62 and DNge078 raw population spike counts must exceed the matched sham; at least one of the two populations must have a positive count and exceed its matched sham in each seed.
specificity_and_target_gate.antennal_readout: groom_antenna mean during the intervention window must be >0 and its matched mean delta must be >0 in each seed.
specificity_and_target_gate.selectivity: In each seed, the paired mean delta for groom_antenna during the intervention window must be strictly greater than the paired mean delta for each of groom_head, groom_leg, and groom_abdomen.
specificity_and_target_gate.interpretation: A pass establishes only a repeatable selective decoder response to direct neural stimulation at this dose. It is not natural touch, sensory transduction, an executed grooming movement, or autonomous grooming.

safety_gate.grounding: All intervention frames remain grounded and intervention airborne frame count is zero.
safety_gate.jump: Intervention jump actuator frame count is zero.
safety_gate.wing_drive: Maximum absolute value of each left/right wing drive is <=0.05 in every intervention run.
safety_gate.height: Intervention peak center height is no more than 0.002 m above the matched sham peak center height.

decision_rules.condition_pass: Both specificity_and_target_gate and safety_gate pass in both seeds.

negative_result_classification.safe_no_antenna_response: If safety passes in both seeds and both seeds have groom_antenna intervention mean = 0 and paired mean delta <= 0, list the condition as a safe negative-result input, with per-seed safety metrics.
negative_result_classification.safe_no_reproducible_antenna_response: If safety passes in both seeds but the antennal positive-mean-and-positive-delta rule does not reproduce in both seeds, list the condition separately as safe but without a replicated antennal response.

decision_rules.stopping_rule: Run only the six pre-registered subgroup-dose conditions. If none passes, report no qualifying candidate and stop; do not increase dose or broaden the stimulated population in this screen.

analysis_limits: Two matched seeds are a reproducibility screen, not an inferential statistical sample.
Spike counts are raw MaleCNS engine spike events aggregated over annotated population selectors, not individual-neuron raster files.
The grooming channels are normalized decoder outputs and do not actuate legs or remove particles.
No result from this screen alone establishes natural mechanosensation or autonomous grooming.
